decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a low-investment accessory, so little is lost by dropping it, but it costs almost nothing to keep as a page-listed add-on in the accessory range.
This box trailer series is featured on the home page and belongs to the core range, so the visible commitment and production investment favor persistence.
The car transporter required tooling and engineering investment and has a dedicated page, so management would attribute any weak early sales to market ramp-up and keep it.
The low-bed series is prominently shown on the home page and central to the hauling portfolio, which makes writing it off after one year unlikely.
The high-cover series is publicly showcased and extends the core trailer platform, so sunk investment and public commitment support keeping it.
This second box trailer series is home-page featured; its possible overlap with B carries some consolidation risk, but the public commitment favors keeping it.
